svg.text: 6. A second credential type, then its revocation
What steps.sh checks. The consumer gets a token from its identity (STS) for every DSP request; the provider asks the consumer's identity for the credentials it
needs and reads the issuer's status lists. Joining (registration and credential requests) happens before step 1 and is left out.
catalog: two datasets checked against the bundle; bed-occupancy rejected (SHACL)
6. POST /v1/negotiations, offers copied from the catalog [management]
FINALIZED, or TERMINATED for changed terms and the auditors' claim
10. GET data address, with the token
completed: the token is refused afterwards
11. negotiate the offer for EU processors (DataProcessorCredential)
the issuer revokes the DataProcessorCredential: its status
